# Data Preparation and Exploration

## Learning objectives

By the end of this chapter, you will be able to:

- Import and inspect datasets in R.
- Clean and wrangle data for ITS analysis.
- Construct time and intervention variables.
- Summarize and visualize outcome trends.
- Validate the analysis dataset.

## Introduction

Reliable ITS analysis begins with well-prepared data. This chapter covers data import, cleaning, aggregation, validation, and exploratory analysis.
